q: The museum's new wing opened in ______ already welcomed more than 50,000 visitors.
e: Ikkita mustaqil gapni faqat vergul bilan ulab bo'lmaydi (comma splice). Nuqtali vergul ikki to'liq gapni to'g'ri bog'laydi.

q: Marie Curie was the first person to win Nobel Prizes in two different ______ physics in 1903 and chemistry in 1911.
e: Ikki nuqta to'liq gapdan keyin uni izohlovchi ro'yxatni kiritadi. Nuqtali vergul va nuqtadan keyin to'liq gap kelishi kerak edi.

q: The Aral Sea, ______ once the fourth-largest lake in the world, has lost most of its water since the 1960s.
e: Vergullar orasidagi qo'shimcha qism «which» bilan boshlanadi. «it was» comma splice yasaydi, «that» esa vergul bilan ishlatilmaydi.

q: The experiment produced surprising ______ the team decided to repeat it before publishing.
e: «therefore» bog'lovchi emas, ravish. Ikki mustaqil gap orasida undan oldin nuqtali vergul, keyin vergul qo'yiladi.

q: The final chapter—which many readers find the most ______ was written only weeks before the author's death.
e: Qo'shimcha qism tire bilan ochilgan bo'lsa, tire bilan yopiladi. Belgilar juft va bir xil bo'lishi kerak.

q: The scientist who first described the ______ a professor at a small university in Peru.
e: Ega (The scientist who first described the species) va kesim (was) orasiga hech qanday tinish belgisi qo'yilmaydi.

q: The recipe requires only three ______ flour, water, and salt.
e: To'liq gapdan keyin ro'yxat ikki nuqta bilan kiritiladi. Nuqtali vergul ro'yxat oldidan qo'yilmaydi.

q: Although the trail was steep and muddy after the ______ the hikers reached the summit before noon.
e: «Although...» ergash gap, mustaqil emas. U bosh gapga vergul bilan ulanadi. Nuqta yoki nuqtali vergul uni yolg'iz qoldiradi.

q: The solar panels were installed in ______ the school's electricity bill has fallen by half.
e: Ikki mustaqil gap «vergul + and» bilan ulanadi. Faqat vergul comma splice, nuqtali verguldan keyin «and» ortiqcha.

q: Students ______ to apply for the scholarship must submit an essay by Friday.
e: «who want to apply» qaysi talabalar ekanini aniqlaydi (restrictive). Bunday qism vergul yoki tire bilan ajratilmaydi.

q: The building's architect, ______ planned the surrounding park as well.
e: Ism appozitiv: vergul bilan ochilgan bo'lsa, vergul bilan yopiladi.

q: The coach gave her team one piece of advice before the ______ stay calm and pass the ball quickly.
e: Ikki nuqta to'liq gapdan keyin «qanday maslahat» ekanini tushuntiradi. Nuqtali verguldan keyin to'liq gap kerak edi.

q: After three years of careful ______ the archaeologists finally reached the lowest layer of the site.
e: Uzun kirish qismidan keyin vergul qo'yiladi. Nuqtali vergul va ikki nuqta oldidan to'liq gap bo'lishi kerak.

q: The tour included Bukhara, ______ Samarkand, known for the Registan; and Khiva, a walled city.
e: Ro'yxat elementlari ichida vergul bo'lsa, elementlar o'zaro nuqtali vergul bilan ajratiladi. Gapning qolgan qismi ham shunday tuzilgan.

q: The first prototype was too heavy to ______ the second one flew for nearly an hour.
e: Ikki mustaqil gap «vergul + but» bilan ulanadi. «but»dan keyin vergul qo'yilmaydi, nuqtali vergul bilan ham ishlatilmaydi.

q: The kit ______ a compass, a map, and a flashlight.
e: Fe'l va uning to'ldiruvchisi orasiga tinish belgisi qo'yilmaydi. Ikki nuqta faqat to'liq gapdan keyin keladi.

q: She had only one goal for the ______ every book on the reading list.
e: Ikki nuqta oldingi to'liq gapdagi «one goal»ni izohlaydi. Nuqtali verguldan keyin to'liq gap kelishi kerak edi.

q: The bicycle ______ I bought last year is already broken.
e: Qaysi velosiped ekanini aniqlovchi qism (restrictive) «that» bilan, vergulsiz yoziladi.

q: The test was ______ most students finished it on time.
e: «however» ikki mustaqil gapni bog'lasa, undan oldin nuqtali vergul, keyin vergul qo'yiladi.

q: The list of required documents for the scholarship application ______ on the university's website.
e: Ega «list» birlikda. «of required documents» oraliq qism, fe'l unga moslashmaydi.

q: Each of the volunteers who cleaned the riverbanks last weekend ______ a certificate.
e: «Each» doim birlik. Shuning uchun fe'l ham birlikda: has received.

q: When the city council finally approved the budget, ______ announced plans to repair every school roof.
e: «council» jamlovchi ot, SAT'da birlik deb olinadi. Unga «it» olmoshi mos keladi.

q: Researchers studied seeds that were nearly 2,000 years old and found that some of ______ could still germinate.
e: Olmosh «seeds» (ko'plik) o'rnida turibdi, shuning uchun «them».

q: By the time the rescue team arrived, the hikers ______ for nearly two days.
e: O'tgan zamondagi voqeadan (arrived) oldin davom etgan harakat Past Perfect Continuous bilan beriladi.

q: Walking through the ancient city of Khiva, ______.
o: the tourists were impressed by the tall minarets
the tall minarets impressed the tourists
the tall minarets were impressive to the tourists
e: Kim yurgan? Turistlar. Kirish qismdan keyin darhol harakatni bajaruvchi kelishi shart (dangling modifier).

q: The ______ collection of rare manuscripts attracts scholars from around the world.
e: Bitta kutubxonaning to'plami: birlik egalik shakli «library's».

q: Both ______ projects were selected for the national science fair.
e: «Both» ikki talabani bildiradi. Ko'plikdagi egalik: students'.

q: The company announced that ______ new factory would open in 2027.
e: «its» egalik olmoshi. «it's» esa «it is» degani. Kompaniya birlik, shuning uchun «their» emas.

q: Over the past decade, the ______ population has grown by nearly 20 percent.
e: Bitta shaharning aholisi: city's.

q: Last summer, the research team ______ a new species of beetle in the mountains.
e: «Last summer» aniq o'tgan vaqt, shuning uchun Past Simple: discovered.

q: The volunteers spent the weekend planting trees, cleaning the riverbank, and ______.
e: Parallel tuzilish: planting, cleaning, painting. Ro'yxat elementlari bir xil shaklda bo'ladi.

q: Of the two proposals, the second is ______.
e: Ikkita narsa taqqoslansa qiyosiy daraja (more) ishlatiladi. Uchta va undan ko'p bo'lsa «most» kerak bo'lardi.

q: Neither the coach nor the players ______ satisfied with the referee's decision.
e: «neither...nor»da fe'l yaqinroq egaga moslashadi: players (ko'plik), shuning uchun «were».

q: The two companies merged last year, and ______ combined revenue now exceeds $2 billion.
e: Ikki kompaniya ko'plik, egalik olmoshi «their». «there» joyni bildiradi.

q: The population of Tashkent is larger than ______.
o: that of any other city in Uzbekistan
e: Aholi aholi bilan taqqoslanadi: «that of». Toshkentning o'zi O'zbekistonda bo'lgani uchun «any other» deyiladi.

q: There ______ several reasons why the experiment failed.
e: «There is/are»da haqiqiy ega fe'ldan keyin keladi: several reasons, ya'ni ko'plik.

q: The quality of the paintings in the exhibition ______ remarkable.
e: Ega «quality» birlikda. «of the paintings in the exhibition» faqat oraliq qism.

q: The award was shared by my sister and ______.
e: «by» predlogidan keyin obyekt kelishigi kerak: me. «my sister»ni olib tashlab tekshiring: shared by me.

q: In 1957, the Soviet Union launched Sputnik 1, which ______ the first artificial satellite to orbit Earth.
e: Voqea 1957 yilda tugagan, shuning uchun Past Simple: became.

q: The committee decided ______ the meeting until next week.
e: «decide»dan keyin infinitiv keladi: decide to do.

q: Learning several languages ______ the brain flexible, according to some researchers.
e: Gerund (Learning...) ega bo'lsa birlik hisoblanadi, shuning uchun «keeps».

q: Three ______ from our school won medals at the regional olympiad.
e: Bu yerda egalik yo'q, oddiy ko'plik kerak: students.

q: Exhausted after the long flight, ______.
o: Aziz fell asleep as soon as he reached the hotel
the hotel bed looked very inviting to Aziz
sleep came quickly for Aziz at the hotel
the hotel was where Aziz fell asleep
e: Kim charchagan? Aziz. Kirish qismdan keyin darhol «Aziz» kelishi kerak.

q: The university updated ______ admissions policy last spring.
e: Universitet bitta tashkilot, egalik olmoshi «its».

q: The new policy will ______ thousands of students.
e: «will»dan keyin fe'lning asosiy shakli keladi. «affect» fe'l (ta'sir qilmoq), «effect» odatda ot (ta'sir).

q: The drought had a serious ______ on the region's farmers.
e: «a serious ...» ot talab qiladi: effect. «have an effect on» birikmasi.

q: This year, ______ students failed the exam than last year.
e: Sanaladigan otlar bilan «fewer», sanalmaydiganlar bilan «less» ishlatiladi.

q: The student ______ essay won the competition will receive a scholarship.
e: Egalik kerak (talabaning inshosi): whose. «who's» esa «who is» degani.

q: The researchers presented ______ findings at the conference.
e: «their» egalik olmoshi. «there» joyni bildiradi, «they're» esa «they are».

q: The team ______ practicing every morning since January.
e: SAT'da jamlovchi ot (team) birlik. «since January» Present Perfect Continuous talab qiladi.

q: One of the oldest mosques in the city ______ being restored.
e: Ega «One», birlik. «of the oldest mosques» uni o'zgartirmaydi.

q: Scientists ______ the Moon's surface for decades, and they continue to make new discoveries.
e: Harakat o'tmishda boshlanib, hozir ham davom etyapti (for decades, continue), shuning uchun Present Perfect.

q: The organizers and ______ will meet tomorrow to discuss the schedule.
e: Ega vazifasida bosh kelishik kerak: I. «The organizers»ni olib tashlab tekshiring: I will meet.

q: Everyone in the two classes ______ to bring a calculator.
e: «Everyone» doim birlik, shuning uchun «needs».

q: The number of electric cars on the roads ______ quickly.
e: «The number of» birlik, «A number of» esa ko'plik. Bu yerda «The number», ya'ni birlik.

q: A number of students ______ asked for extra practice tests.
e: «A number of» bir nechta degani va ko'plik fe'l talab qiladi: have asked.

q: The tree lost most of ______ leaves in the storm.
e: Bitta daraxtning barglari: egalik olmoshi «its». «its'» degan shakl umuman yo'q.

q: The coach told us to drink more water, to sleep longer, and ______.
o: we should stretch before every run
stretch before every run is needed
e: Parallel tuzilish: to drink, to sleep, to stretch.

q: ______, the students finished the project two days early.
o: Having been worked late every evening
e: «Working...» kirish qismi, uni darhol bajaruvchi «the students» kuzatib keladi. Boshqa variantlar grammatik jihatdan noto'g'ri.

q: Students must ______ their identification cards at the entrance.
e: Modal fe'ldan (must) keyin fe'lning asosiy shakli keladi.

q: The results of the survey ______ surprising.
e: Ega «results» ko'plikda, shuning uchun «were».

q: The new phone is lighter ______ the old model.
e: Taqqoslashda «than» ishlatiladi, «then» esa «keyin» degani.

q: The scientist ______ discovered penicillin was Alexander Fleming.
e: Inson uchun ega vazifasida «who» ishlatiladi. «which» narsalar uchun.

q: The new car uses ______ fuel than the old one.
e: Yoqilg'i sanalmaydigan ot, shuning uchun «less».

q: Many people assume that bats are blind. ______ most bat species can see quite well, and some even see colors.
e: Ikkinchi gap noto'g'ri tasavvurni rad etib, haqiqatni aytadi. Bunga «In fact» mos keladi.

q: The bridge had been closed for repairs for six months. ______ drivers had to take a much longer route through the mountains.
e: Ko'prik yopilgani sabab, uzun yo'l esa uning natijasi. Shuning uchun «As a result».

q: Several cities have found creative ways to reduce traffic. ______ Seoul removed an elevated highway and restored the stream that ran beneath it.
e: Seul umumiy fikrga (creative ways) aniq misol bo'lyapti.

q: The new library offers free English classes for adults. ______ it lends laptops to students who do not have computers at home.
e: Kutubxonaning yana bir xizmati qo'shilyapti, shuning uchun «Additionally».

q: Early critics dismissed the novel as too long and confusing. ______ it is now taught in universities around the world.
e: Avvalgi salbiy baho va hozirgi muvaffaqiyat bir-biriga zid, shuning uchun «however».

q: First, the students collected water samples from the river. ______ they tested each sample for bacteria in the school laboratory.
e: Harakatlar ketma-ketligi: First, keyin Next.

q: The village has no hospital. ______ it does have a small clinic that is open twice a week.
e: Kasalxona yo'q, lekin klinika bor. Bu qarama-qarshilik, shuning uchun «However».

q: Bees pollinate many of the crops that humans eat. ______ the decline of bee populations worries farmers around the world.
e: Asalarilarning muhimligi fermerlar xavotirining sababi, shuning uchun «Therefore».

q: The study found that sleep improves memory. ______ students who slept eight hours remembered more words than those who slept five.
e: Ikkinchi gap umumiy natijani aniq raqamlar bilan tushuntiradi, shuning uchun «Specifically».

q: Cats can sleep up to 16 hours a day. ______ lions spend most of the day resting.
e: Ikki hayvonning odati o'xshash, shuning uchun «Similarly».

q: The town council did not build a new parking lot. ______ it used the land to create a public garden.
e: Bitta ish o'rniga boshqasi qilingan, shuning uchun «Instead».

q: In the morning, the students took their final exam. ______ their teachers were preparing the graduation ceremony in the main hall.
e: Ikki harakat bir vaqtda bo'lyapti, shuning uchun «Meanwhile».

q: This medicine should not be taken by people with heart disease. ______ patients with heart problems need a different treatment.
e: Ikkinchi gap birinchisini boshqa so'zlar bilan qayta aytadi, shuning uchun «In other words».

q: The weather forecast predicted heavy rain all weekend. ______ thousands of fans came to the outdoor concert.
e: Yomg'irga qaramay odamlar kelgan. Kutilganiga zid natija «Nevertheless» bilan beriladi.

q: The engineers tested dozens of designs over three years. ______ they chose a lightweight model made of carbon fiber.
e: Uzoq jarayonning yakuniy natijasi «Ultimately» bilan beriladi.

q: In cold climates, houses often have small windows to keep heat inside. ______ houses in hot climates may have wide windows and high ceilings.
e: Sovuq va issiq iqlimdagi uylar qarama-qarshi qo'yilyapti, shuning uchun «Conversely».

q: The bridge can hold only ten tons. ______ heavy trucks must use the eastern route.
e: Ko'prikning cheklovi yuk mashinalari uchun xulosaga olib keladi, shuning uchun «Thus».

q: The new bus line is faster than the old one. ______ it costs passengers less.
e: Yana bir afzallik qo'shilyapti, shuning uchun «Moreover».

q: Some birds use tools to find food. ______ New Caledonian crows bend twigs into hooks to pull insects out of tree bark.
e: Qarg'alar umumiy fikrga aniq misol bo'lyapti.

q: The hotel was far from the city center and quite expensive. ______ guests praised its friendly staff and beautiful garden.
e: Kamchiliklarga qaramay ijobiy fikr bildirilyapti. Bu qarama-qarshilik, shuning uchun «Still».

q: The author's first novel was rejected by twelve publishers. ______ it sold more than a million copies.
e: Rad etilish va keyingi muvaffaqiyat bir-biriga zid, voqea vaqt o'tib yuz bergan, shuning uchun «Eventually, though».

q: Regular exercise improves heart health. ______ a diet rich in vegetables lowers the risk of heart disease.
e: Ikki odat yurak uchun bir xil foyda beradi, shuning uchun «Likewise».

q: The northern part of the country receives heavy rainfall. ______ the south is dry for most of the year.
e: Shimol va janub qarama-qarshi qo'yilyapti, shuning uchun «In contrast».

q: The factory switched from coal to natural gas. ______ local air quality improved within a year.
e: Havo sifatining yaxshilanishi yoqilg'i almashtirilishining natijasi, shuning uchun «Consequently».

q: Students can submit their essays online. ______ they can bring a printed copy to the main office.
e: Ikkinchi gap boshqa variantni taklif qiladi, shuning uchun «Alternatively».

q: The festival has grown enormously in recent years. ______ it now attracts visitors from more than forty countries.
e: Ikkinchi gap birinchisini kuchaytirib tasdiqlaydi, shuning uchun «Indeed».

q: Remember to save your work every few minutes. ______ you might lose hours of effort if the computer crashes.
e: Saqlamasangiz nima bo'lishi aytilyapti, shuning uchun «Otherwise».

q: Today, the trip from Tashkent to Samarkand takes about two hours by high-speed train. ______ the journey by road usually took about twice as long.
e: Hozirgi va avvalgi holat taqqoslanyapti, shuning uchun «Previously».
